shared_elements: worked stone surface with shallow incised/low-relief linear carving
bilaterally symmetrical motif on a central vertical axis
paired curved/hooked scroll-like elements near the top
stacked horizontal registers or bands of decoration
justification: Both are tall, roughly rectangular stone objects whose decoration is organised symmetrically about a central vertical axis in stacked registers, and each includes a prominent circular/ring element with paired curling hooks above it. But A is a flat, thin plaque bearing a crisply engraved line inscription and a foliate cross of draughtsman-like precision, whereas B is a massive three-dimensional carved figure whose weathered, blunt relief motifs are subordinate to its sculpted human form.
